|strategy=[[Mara Jade]], the Emperor's hand, went undercover and posed as a dancer for crime lord [[Jabba]] the Hutt. This identity was used from the time of The Empire Strikes Back till shortly after [[Jabba]]'s demise.

The final [[Arica]] card image was suggested by depictions of [[Arica]] in stories published by Dark Horse Comics.<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/reflections2/dark/small/arica.html</ref>
